thread:
Sara (customer): streaming from our Next.js edge function is stalling after the SDK retries. We see a 502 from the upstream and then the ReadableStream in the browser stops yielding. Using Node 18 on Vercel Edge, @redwood/inference@2.1.0.

Ryan (support): thanks, sorry about that. Can you share a tiny repro and the exact SDK call? Also which edge provider/runtime?

Sara (customer): Vercel Edge (edge). Minimal API route below: 
```
// app/api/stream/route.ts (edge)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
export const runtime = 'edge'
export async function GET() {
  const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
  const res = await client.stream.chat({ model: 'gpt-open-1', messages: [{role:'user', content:'test streaming'}], max_tokens: 150 })
  return new Response(res.body)
}
```
On v2.1.0 the client logs "retrying request" once and then the connection from Vercel to our app returns 502. The browser never gets more chunks after the second chunk.

Ryan (support): can you try two quick things: 1) pin @redwood/inference to v2.0.3 and confirm, 2) run curl -i against the route and paste headers + raw body? We want to see Transfer-Encoding and chunk boundaries.

Sara (customer): pinned to v2.0.3 and stream completes. With 2.1.0 it fails reproducibly. curl output (trimmed):

> curl -i https://example.vercel.app/api/stream
HTTP/2 502
date: Fri, 02 May 2025 14:12:11 GMT
content-type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
transfer-encoding: chunked

<chunk1 bytes>
<chunk2 bytes>
-- then nothing, connection hangs until client timeout

Matt (eng-runtime): that matches a regression we introduced in 2.1.0. Our streaming retry wrapper attempted to re-run the upstream fetch by cloning/rewinding the inner ReadableStream. On Node edge runtimes you cannot reattach a consumed stream, so the wrapper ends up leaving the outer Response.body locked and half-consumed. Upstream proxy (Vercel) sees a malformed/closed body path and returns 502; downstream never resumes.

Ryan (support): short-term workarounds: 1) pin to 2.0.3, or 2) set REDWOOD_STREAM_RETRIES=0 to disable automatic streaming retries and handle retry logic at the CDN/proxy layer. Could you test the env var?

Sara (customer): set REDWOOD_STREAM_RETRIES=0 in Vercel and stream is stable again. Thanks. Will keep pinned until a patch lands.

Matt (eng-runtime): we pushed a fix that changes streaming retry behavior: instead of cloning the full ReadableStream we buffer a small prefix and only retry when safe, avoiding reusing the original edge stream. PR merged to staging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412. We'll backport to the 2.1.x branch and cut a 2.1.1 patch today.

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-9876 for customer follow-up and release notes.

Ryan (support): thanks for confirming the env var workaround, Sara. We'll notify in CS-9876 when 2.1.1 is released. Matt — will customers need to redeploy edge functions or just update the package?

Matt (eng-runtime): SDK update only for hosted/edge SDK usage. For Dedicated/Private there is a runtime component and we'll include upgrade steps in the ticket. No redeploy required beyond updating the npm dependency (or set env var as temp fix).

Sara (customer): great, keeping REDWOOD_STREAM_RETRIES=0 for now. Please ping when 2.1.1 is out. :thumbsup:
